carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Meta Agrees to Pay $18 Billion and Overhaul Teen Safety in Landmark Settlement With 47 States
carousel.excerpt: The largest tech settlement in history ends a trial over youth social media addiction, requiring daily time limits, night mode, and hidden like counts for minors on Facebook and Instagram.
carousel.image_caption: Meta has agreed to pay approximately $18 billion in a landmark settlement with 47 US states over teen safety concerns on its social media platforms.
carousel.nri_angle: The settlement could reshape how Indian-American families manage their children's social media use, with mandatory time limits and parental controls becoming default on Meta's platforms.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Hanuman Ansh Declared a Box Office Success After Miraculous Third-Week Surge
carousel.excerpt: The devotional drama collected approximately 8 crore rupees in 19 days after a massive word-of-mouth turnaround, with third-week earnings exceeding its first two weeks combined.
carousel.nri_angle: The film’s success mirrors the growing appetite for devotional and mythological content among Indian audiences worldwide, following the blockbuster HanuMan (2024).
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: DDCA to Review DPL Selection Rules After Dev Chaudhary Controversy Exposes Loopholes
carousel.excerpt: The controversial selection of little-known cricketer Dev Chaudhary by New Delhi Tigers has put the Delhi Premier League's player-selection process under intense scrutiny, prompting promises of rule changes.
carousel.nri_angle: The DPL selection controversy raises questions about transparency and meritocracy in Indian domestic cricket, resonating with diaspora fans who follow Indian cricket closely.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: WhatsApp Replaces Six-Digit PINs With Full Passwords, Adds Multiple Passkeys
carousel.excerpt: Meta's messaging platform overhauls two-step verification, expands passkey support beyond one billion users, and gives Android callers new scam warnings.
carousel.image_caption: WhatsApp is replacing six-digit PINs with alphanumeric passwords and expanding passkey support as part of a major security overhaul. The changes target account takeovers and scam calls affecting the platforms 2.7 billion users worldwide.
carousel.nri_angle: WhatsApp is the primary communication lifeline for Indian diaspora families staying connected across continents, making these security upgrades directly relevant to millions of NRI users.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India's Sugar Market Swings From Surplus to Shortage as Prices Hit Record Ahead of Festivals
carousel.excerpt: What began as a season of oversupply and falling prices has turned into a scramble to contain record sugar costs, forcing New Delhi to allow imports for the first time in nearly a decade.
